---
name: Agent evaluation or regression
about: Record a reproducible failure and a bounded agent iteration
title: "[Agent evaluation] "
---

## Role, surface and version

Agent file and commit; editor/harness or cloud execution environment; model;
enabled tools; relevant policy; date.

## Reproduction

Exact synthetic input, expected output/boundary, observed output, and sanitized
tool trace. No credentials or private external data.

## Score and impact

Use [Lab 4's comparison steps](../../workshop/labs/04-handoff-review.md#46-compare-and-improve-one-instruction).
Separate behavior from test coverage.

## Bounded improvement

One proposed instruction/tool change, owner, time limit, and regression cases.

## Evidence for closure

Before/after results on the same inputs, remaining limitations and review decision.
